name: Nixy Thrumdazzle
intro: You've read the histories, studied the arts arcane, and played the taverns. Waterdeep is a city of stories, and you know more of them than most.

sections.heading: You know magic and its institutions
sections.because: Sage background · Arcana proficiency · Magic Initiate (Wizard)
extra: As a dabbler in wizardry, you'd be welcome in the Watchful Order, if you can pay the dues.

sections.heading: You know the Death Curse as a scholar
extra: Every scholar in the city has a theory, and you've heard most of them. None has been proven.

sections.heading: You know the stages and the audiences
extra: The songs at the Yawning Portal have turned sadder since the Death Curse.
Noble winter balls hire musicians. That's good money, and a good place to overhear things.
Every performer in the city has heard a ghost story about the empty tavern in Trollskull Alley.

sections.heading: You know your own people
extra: A gnomish bard will rarely be short of an audience, or a bed.

lists.heading: Tools and languages
items: **Calligrapher's Supplies:** the scribes and copyists of the city's temples, wizards and guilds always need a fine hand.
**Shawm, bagpipes and zulkoon:** loud, unusual and memorable. A zulkoon in particular is a rare sight on the Sword Coast. ⚠ verify the zulkoon's origin if it matters.

story: *Not written yet. Talk to your DM about where Nixy studied, what they performed, and why they came to Waterdeep. This section will grow with your backstory.*

secrets.because: History and Arcana proficiency. You know both the old histories and how the curse works.
Investigation proficiency. You're one of the people who know things.
